name: Maugdred Influencer (CR 1/2)
body:
MAUGDRED INFLUENCER
CR 1/2

This humanoid has rubbery green skin, a wide mouth, and large black eyes. Instead of hair, its head is topped by a mane of octopus-like tentacles.

XP 200
Maugdred mystic 1
LN Medium humanoid (aquatic, maugdred)
Init +2; Senses blindsense 30 ft. (only if touching the same body of water), darkvision 120 ft. (underwater only); Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +2 armor, +1 shield)
hp 11 (1d8+2+1)
Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5
Defensive Abilities share pain (6/day, DC 13)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee spear +1 (1d8+1/×3 P; brace)
Ranged light crossbow +2 (1d8 P, 19-20/×2, range incr. 80 ft.; AP 1)

Mystic Spells Known (CL 1st; concentration +4)

0-level (at will)—daze (DC 14), detect magic, ghost sound (DC 13), message
1st-level (2/day)—charm person (DC 15), lesser confusion (DC 15), mind thrust IOA (DC 14)

Connection Mindbreaker; connection spells

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 17, Cha 8
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 13
Feats Spell Focus (enchantment)
Skills Diplomacy +3, Heal +7, Perception +7, Sense Motive +9, Survival +7, Swim +9; Species Modifiers +2 Sense Motive
Languages Common, Maugdred
SQ amphibious, healing touch (4/day, 1d6)
Gear NPC gear (leather armor, light wooden shield, light crossbow with 10 bolts, spear, other gear)

ABOUT

Comfortable on both land and sea, maugdreds are known for calm and patience, with a culture focused on ancient traditions. Within their society, maugdred influencers are feared and respected for their ability to control any situation. They have the ability to heal the wounded, to calm the hostile, or to cloud the minds of their enemies.
